import math

def main():
    x, y, n = map(float, input().split())
    x = float(x)
    y = float(y)
    n = int(n)
    
    best_dif = 1e9
    best_a = 0
    best_b = 1
    
    for b in range(1, n + 1):
        ratio = x / y
        a1 = math.ceil(b * ratio)
        a2 = math.floor(b * ratio)
        
        diff1 = abs(ratio - a1 / b)
        diff2 = abs(ratio - a2 / b)
        
        if diff2 < best_dif:
            best_dif = diff2
            best_a = int(a2)
            best_b = b
        if diff1 < best_dif:
            best_dif = diff1
            best_a = int(a1)
            best_b = b
    
    print(f"{best_a}/{best_b}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
